A bill for an act relating to education; allowing school districts to access personnel files of prospective teachers from their employing districts; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, sections 122A.40, by adding a subdivision; 122A.41, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 122A.40, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 3a.+]

[+District access to prospective teacher's personnel file.+]

[+Notwithstanding section 13.43, a district seeking to fill a teaching position that schedules an interview with a prospective teacher currently employed by a Minnesota school district may request from the teacher's district access to the teacher's personnel file for inspection. The teacher's employing district must make the contents of the teacher's personnel file available to the hiring district for inspection and must inform the teacher that access to the teacher's personnel file has been requested. The hiring district must not use the contents of the teacher's personnel file to cancel a scheduled interview with the teacher. +]

Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 122A.41, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 1a.+]

[+District access to prospective teacher's personnel file.+]

[+Notwithstanding section 13.43, a district seeking to fill a teaching position that schedules an interview with a prospective teacher currently employed by a Minnesota school district may request from the teacher's district access to the teacher's personnel file for inspection. The teacher's employing district must make the contents of the teacher's personnel file available to the hiring district for inspection and must inform the teacher that access to the teacher's personnel file has been requested. The hiring district must not use the contents of the teacher's personnel file to cancel a scheduled interview with the teacher. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; allowing school districts to access personnel files of prospective teachers from their employing districts; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, sections 122A.40, by adding a subdivision; 122A.41, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 122A.40, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 3a.

District access to prospective teacher's personnel file.

Notwithstanding section 13.43, a district seeking to fill a teaching position that schedules an interview with a prospective teacher currently employed by a Minnesota school district may request from the teacher's district access to the teacher's personnel file for inspection. The teacher's employing district must make the contents of the teacher's personnel file available to the hiring district for inspection and must inform the teacher that access to the teacher's personnel file has been requested. The hiring district must not use the contents of the teacher's personnel file to cancel a scheduled interview with the teacher.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 122A.41, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 1a.

District access to prospective teacher's personnel file.

Notwithstanding section 13.43, a district seeking to fill a teaching position that schedules an interview with a prospective teacher currently employed by a Minnesota school district may request from the teacher's district access to the teacher's personnel file for inspection. The teacher's employing district must make the contents of the teacher's personnel file available to the hiring district for inspection and must inform the teacher that access to the teacher's personnel file has been requested. The hiring district must not use the contents of the teacher's personnel file to cancel a scheduled interview with the teacher.
